### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: CENTRAL_BANK_COMPANY in the generator -- 49 of E&F's bank
### companies, the ones that were their country's actual central bank, checked
### against the tag E&F grants each of them in establish_bank_and_ef_compagnie.
###
### NOT all 97, and that is the whole point. `building_types` is the only real
### lock on who may own a building: while every bank company carried
### building_bank, Banca d'Italia privatised four levels of the Papal central
### bank away from the company holding the monopoly. A monopoly is a price and
### construction rule; this list is the lock.
###
### These keep the assets they already own -- the Banque de France comes with
### its ten levels of private construction and five of the Bourse de Paris -- and
### the generated per-currency company is used only where no historical central
### bank exists. See zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
###
### REPLACE:, because INJECT: can only add. The first version of this file was an
### INJECT: and the Bank of England kept buying railways: E&F's own list still
### held building_railway and building_trade_center, and nothing short of
### restating the entry takes an entry off it. Each block below is E&F's own,
### copied verbatim, with three edits -- building_bank added, those two removed,
### the three regime currencies appended to possible_prestige_goods.
###
### E&F's own prestige goods stay: they sit on other base goods
### (manufacture_stock and friends) and never compete with the three currencies,
### which all share spe_uni_c.
###
### company_BasicBank is NOT here any more. It used to be the fallback owner,
### with building_bank injected onto it -- but E&F offers it to every country
### as an ordinary company, so that quietly let any bank company anywhere buy
### a central bank, and it showed up in Bunyoro as a company called "Bank"
### owning railways. The fallback is zz_ef_cm_central_bank now; see
### zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
